d: Rekha, a timid woman, has the ability to perceive spirits. When she encounters a malevolent black magic practitioner, she is drawn into unravelling dark occult mysteries, putting her life at risk.
An undercover cop is given a secret assignment by the home minister to put an end to a smuggling ring.
A former counter-terrorism agent sets out to exact revenge on the friends who betray him and work for a secret agency.
A woman begins to chase down the culprits after her handbag is stolen. However, things take a turn when the thieves find weapons in their loot, causing them to question the identity of their victim.
Deva, a former gold smuggler, seeks to regain past glory by reviving his old gang with stolen technology hidden in vintage golden watches, leading to unintended consequences.
A resident of Dharavi unites the people living in his area to stand up against a ruthless politician who dreams of taking over their land.
Provoked by Chandrika, Ramakrishna relives his past romance with Priya who was killed accidentally by her father. Furthermore, is he able to trace his son?
A small business owner gets new political ambitions after meeting the prime minister.
Yuva beats up a drug lord while trying to help the woman he loves and faces various threats aimed at his family.
When a man loses job and faces financial ruin, he enters the illegal arms trade, eventually becoming South India's most notorious arms dealer.
